name: maybe_g_uiBusyFlag

evidence: three readers compare *slot == '\0': maybe_Actor_AdjustHeightParam (plus per-actor byte +0xF1F), maybe_Ui_PartyStatus_AddValue (plus per-panel byte) and maybe_Battle_Ui_SpawnSoundBalloon; the readable header of AddValue calls it the global 'status screen busy' flag; slots 0x001CABF0, 0x001CCB30, 0x001F5F4C all hold 0x007A58F8

name: g_globalMutexObject
comment: Opaque global OS lock object: its address is passed to Os_MutexLock / Os_SetSyncState and the semaphore calls, and it serialises the sound-stream teardown, actor state-flag updates and the icon-cache thread. Only the address matters to modders.
evidence: maybe_Sound_StreamThreads_Shutdown calls maybe_Os_MutexLock(g_00384040); maybe_Actor_ApplyStateFlags calls maybe_Os_MutexLock(uVar1 = g_00383eb0); Ui_IconCache_WorkerThread calls maybe_Os_SetSyncState/Os_TryLockSemaphore/Os_LockSemaphore on g_00412930; slots 0x00383EB0/0x00384040/0x00412930 all hold 0x007AE4E0

name: g_actor2DHandleTable

evidence: Actor2DMoveEx, Actor2DMove, NPCTalkSetup and maybe_Actor_SetValueByIndex all index (handle & 0x3F) * 8 and compare word +4 with handle >> 6; the first entry is zero and 0x007B7D94 = 0x03FFFFFF sentinel; slots 0x00147BA8/0x0014A708/0x0014B7DC hold 0x007B7D90
